author: Okkerka
name: Moderation
short: Moderation, filtered cleanup and member history
description: Prefix and slash moderation commands, protected message cleanup, confirmed dehoisting and persistent moderation history.
install_msg: Use `[p]help Moderation`. Existing custom moderator restrictions remain in effect. Read the cog README for slash setup and new commands.
end_user_data_statement: Stores server moderator and blocked-user IDs, warnings, temporary bans and up to 500 recent moderation actions per target user per server, including moderator IDs, timestamps and descriptions. New history begins with this version.
